violation_type.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs  - Fulcrum Seesaws (26 TAC §746.4605(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs  - Fulcrum Seesaws
violation_type.typical_finding: There was a fulcrum seesaw on the 3 and 4 year old playground.

finding_variants.text: There was a fulcrum seesaw on the 3 and 4 year old playground.
A Teeter Totter was observed on the playground.     Note: The Teeter Totter was removed from the playground.
There was a fulcrum seesaw on the playground that children younger than five used. This was corrected during the inspection when the seesaw was removed from the playground.

Based on the evidence gathered, a two-year-old child was allowed to play on a fulcrum seesaw while in care, which resulted in a minor injury. This was corrected at inspection when the fulcrum seesaw was removed from the playground and made inaccessible to children younger than 5 years of age.
The operation has a fulcrum seesaws on the playground.
